design_condition: The slim volume is extended along the highway on a specially engineered foundation, while the canopy addresses the road and protects a broad, quiet outdoor space on the opposite side.

positive.statement: The foundation concept is intelligently thought out and enables uniform load transfer to the settlement-sensitive subsoil.
The special foundation allows increased multi-story storage and reduces the building footprint.
The height development is used to accommodate the highway, while the canopy accentuates the road reference and provides noise protection.
The northern outdoor space impresses with its width, spaciousness, and meaningful emptiness.
The project impresses with its rigorous independence and strikingly expresses its function as a mountain.
The seriousness and precision with which the project idea was developed become apparent on closer examination.

negative.statement: The delivery arrangement allows only one vehicle and is unacceptable given the expected vehicle movements.
The necessary transshipment space is not provided, although goods can only be moved within the building using forklifts.
The ship-shaped volume is unsuitable for the collection-center function because its loading arrangement does not replicate the required ferry-like loading volume.
The first stage appears amputated, while the uncertain second stage and possible expansion are constitutive elements of the concept.
The canopy extending beyond the distance line represents a violation of building law.
The strength of the image is contradicted by important functional inadequacies.
The building's hermeticism turns against the desired spatial and communicative openness of the collection center.
